message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through our old board games while looking for our emergency go-bags. It was a delightful trip down memory lane! 🎲 I realized that while it’s important to be prepared for emergencies, sometimes the best plans include cozy family nights filled with laughter and low-tech fun. It reminded me that keeping our spirits high is just as essential as packing supplies. What’s your favorite way to reconnect with loved ones?
